thirdSection.firstStep: To ensure the ease of the delivery process, you must provide us with a clear delivery address, and the delivery address must contain (mobile number, building number, street name, city, governorate, postal code).
thirdSection.secondStep: Please check the delivery address and contact number to avoid delays in delivery.
thirdSection.thirdStep: After submitting the purchase order, the time required to deliver orders within the Riyadh region is only two working days. The time required to deliver orders outside Riyadh is from 4 to 7 working days from the date of the order.
thirdSection.fourthStep: We cannot make deliveries during weekends and official holidays, so all deliveries will arrive at your door on a weekday from Sunday to Thursday.
thirdSection.fifthStep: VAT (14%) is added to the total order amount on all local orders (within the Arab Republic of Egypt).
thirdSection.sixthStep: Products cannot be shipped to an incomplete address or to an address different from the address specified in the purchase order.
thirdSection.seventhStep: In the event that you cannot be contacted or refuse to receive the product for any reason other than an error in the order sent to you by the online store, you hereby agree to pay the delivery fee only, or deduct it from the amount paid online in the Resala store.
thirdSection.eighthStep: For international shipments, if you refuse to pay customs or taxes that may apply in the destination country, the shipment will be returned back to our warehouses, but you will bear the shipping cost and any additional fees that may be paid as mentioned above.
thirdSection.ninthStep: Upon completion of delivery, please sign the delivery receipt to confirm that there are no defects in the delivery box and the product(s).
thirdSection.eleventhStep: Resala Store will not deal or provide any services or products to any of the countries subject to sanctions from the Office of Foreign Assets Control according to the law of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Return and Refund Policy
thirdSection.returnConditions: We will gladly receive your return and refund request according to the following conditions:
thirdSection.thirteenthStep: We accept the return of goods within 7 days from the date of delivery.
thirdSection.fourteenthStep: Returned goods must be in the same condition as they were delivered and have never been used with the original box, including any stickers, cards, or accessories attached to the product or inside the box and the policy is not attached directly to the product box.
thirdSection.fifteenthStep: The customer must pay the shipping cost to return the order unless the reason for the return is due to the Resala. Store team.
thirdSection.sixteenthStep: Ministry of Commerce instructions regarding the terms of exchange and return.
thirdSection.seventeenthStep: You can request a return of your order by logging into your account in the Resala. Store, then clicking on the “My Orders” page, then choosing the order you want to return in full or in part, and choosing the reason for the return. For further assistance, please contact Resala. Customer Service at 8001247272 during business days from Sunday to Thursday (8 am - 5 pm).
thirdSection.eighteenthStep: Once we receive the order and review the details, we will contact you to discuss the reason for the return. Based on that, we can determine whether the order will be accepted or not within 3 business days.
thirdSection.ninteenthStep: If the final decision is to accept the return of the item(s), we will notify the shipping company to pick up the goods from your address and return them to Ajlan & Bros. Company for local orders, and for international orders, if there is a product error or defect in the goods, Ajlan & Bros. Store bears the shipping cost. The customer is responsible for shipping the product(s) to Ajlan & Bros. warehouse.
thirdSection.twentyStep: If you used (credit or debit card) to pay for the order, the amount paid will be refunded to your card. The refunded amount will be reflected in your card based on the banking operations of each bank, as it takes a month in some cases.
thirdSection.twenty1Step: In case of cash on delivery, please provide us with your bank account details to refund the amount (IBAN, bank name, account holder name).

fourthSection.firstStep: Contact us via the following email: ecommerce.cs@Resala.com. Provide the reason for requesting a return of the product and explanation of the return.
fourthSection.secondStep: Please repack the items in the original box, add any tags or labels that came with the product or in the box, and do not attach the shipping label directly to the outer product box as this may damage the box.
fourthSection.thirdStep: We will notify the shipping company to pick up the goods from your address and return them to Resala.
fourthSection.fourthStep: The shipping company official will contact you within 3 to 5 business days to set the pickup date, in some cases it may take longer.
fourthSection.fifthStep: Once the products are received and pass inspection to confirm their condition, the refund process will be initiated.
